tool.name: Mr. Zurkon – Voice assistant
tool.description: Talk to your assistant: offline wake word, speech recognition and answers read aloud.
tool.long_description: Listens offline for a wake word ("Hey Zurkon", Vosk), records the question and reads the answer aloud – with a system voice, Piper (offline, natural voices) or the voice of a connected provider. Speech recognition by a provider or offline with Whisper local or Vosk. Language and voice can be chosen freely. The conversation runs in an embedded chat with the same assistants, functions and confirmations as the chat panel. Audio goes to the current default output device.
va.deps: The voice assistant needs Python packages for audio access (numpy, soundcard, about 20 MB). They go into the shared package folder of the AI tools.
va.talk_tip: Speak a question directly without the wake word
va.variants_hint: other spellings, separated by commas (e.g. hey clunk)
